changelog:
v3.5.0 — Chapters, Resume Dialog & UX Improvements

• Auto-generated chapter markers for VOD/Series with Prev/Next Chapter skip buttons
• Resume or Play from Beginning dialog when opening content with saved progress
• Continue Watching now shows only the latest episode per series (no duplicates)
• Episode dates shown on series detail cards
• All previous fixes included (buffer, decoder recovery, hero trailer, seek overlay)
